ctx.x: Scott Hamilton plays the tenor saxophone in a manner that harkens back to the era of Coleman Hawkins and Ben Webster. Born in Providence, RI in 1954, his move to New York at the age of 22 proved fruitful. After establishing himself as a player of authority, he found work with Benny Goodman, Rosemary Clooney and formed a working partnership with Warren Vache.
